notes: 修复跨机同步后技能管理报 Skills Source file is unreadable: ledger.json: Expected ',' or '}'：根因 Get-AppRootPattern 兜底正则的否定字符类与看前/看后断言没排除反斜杠，把 G:\DeepSeekHarness\ 结尾的 \ 连同目录名一起吞掉，JSON 里的 \" 变成裸 "，字符串提前闭合，导致 mnemon 下 ledger.json/evals.json/trajectories 损坏。0.4.07 让正则在看前/看后与字符类中都排除反斜杠，普通路径仍正确转 {{APP_ROOT}}，JSON 转义 \\ 保持不变；配套 dsh-sync-common.ps1 BOM 与 PS5.1 语法防回归。
notesEn: Fix 'Skills Source file is unreadable: ledger.json: Expected , or }' after cross-machine sync. Root cause: Get-AppRootPattern's fallback regex did not exclude backslashes in its lookaround and character class, so it swallowed the trailing backslash together with G:\DeepSeekHarness, turning JSON \" into a bare quote and closing the string early — corrupting ledger.json/evals.json/trajectories under mnemon. 0.4.07 excludes backslashes in the lookaround and character class: plain paths still map to {{APP_ROOT}}, JSON escapes stay intact. Includes BOM and PS5.1 syntax regression guards for dsh-sync-common.ps1.
